blurb: Andy Constan is a macro investor and market strategist with institutional pedigree spanning Brevan Howard, Bridgewater Associates, and Salomon Brothers. He is co-creator of the @2Graybeards platform, focused on investor education in macro and beta strategies. He is best known for the 'Damped Spring' volatility model — a conceptual framework that treats market responses to news as a physical spring-mass-damper system, mapping force (news), mass (market), spring constant (stabilizing agents), and damping (shock absorbers) to forecast how markets find new equilibriums after shocks. He posts consistently on macro regime analysis, volatility dynamics, and market structure for a financially literate audience.
